findings.label: Plafon/finalize target not role-validated
findings.detail: plafon() and finalkan() accept any integer katimker_sikep_user_id without checking it is an active Katimker. Orphan override rows are harmless because hitung() only reads overrides for ids returned by listKatimker(), but an isKatimker() guard would avoid accumulating dead rows.

findings.label: Total% unbounded above 100 on bad weights
findings.detail: persen_total is not independently clamped, so component weights summing above 100 would push total% past 100. The Konfigurasi Insentif page enforces a 100% total before save, so this is latent and not reachable through the UI. A defensive min(100, ...) on the total would make the invariant hold regardless of config state.

findings.label: 2FA enforced at group level, not per-route
findings.detail: The three new routes inherit 2FA from the shared ['auth','active-role','two-factor'] group middleware rather than declaring it per-route, matching IncentiveConfigController. Correct today; protection depends on the group staying configured.
